title: Container Bookings: Amending a Live Booking
content:
Changes to the particulars of a live Container Bookings booking are amendments. This page sets the conditions and charges for such amendments.

## Clauses in force

**Scope and status.** Acting on the verified customer's instruction, the desk may change four particulars of a live booking: its equipment type, its number of containers, its discharge port and its cargo category. Amendments, their log entries and any amendment charge are accepted only on a booking whose status is confirmed or equipment released, as the booking record shows.

**Deadline.** An amendment is accepted only if it arrives no later than the product's amendment lead time, in hours, ahead of the cargo cut-off of the allocated vessel. The deadline is the cargo cut-off time brought forward by those lead hours, each a full sixty minutes, in the local time of the port of loading; an amendment arriving exactly at the deadline is accepted.

**Log and count.** Each accepted amendment is logged as one amendment log entry on the booking. The amendment count used below is the number of amendment log entries already on the booking ahead of the amendment now being handled.

**Port of discharge.** A change of port of discharge is possible only on a product that permits it. Such a change still counts towards the free amendment allowance.

**Other amendments.** Any other amendment is free while the amendment count is below the product's free allowance, and once the count has reached the allowance it is charged the product's amendment fee, a single time for that amendment.

**Quantity.** A quantity increase is limited to the product's increase percentage applied to the count confirmed on the booking, with any fraction of a container dropped, and it is further subject to space; the added containers are billed freight under the freight billing rules. Lowering the quantity is an amendment, not a cancellation, and carries no cancellation fee.

**Cargo category.** A new cargo category must remain one that the product accepts.

**Sailing.** A customer's request to change the sailing is not an amendment; it is a roll caused by the customer, handled under the roll rules.

## Clause no longer in force

The earlier pricing of a change of port of discharge as the product's per-container change-of-destination rate multiplied by the booking's whole container quantity, whatever the free allowance, is no longer in force; the change-of-destination fee is now reckoned under the current basis for that fee.

## Deadline boundary (hypothetical)

With a cargo cut-off at 18:00 on day D and a lead time of 48 hours, the deadline is 18:00 on day D less two. An amendment received at 18:00 that day is accepted; one received at 18:05 is not.

## Allowance truth table (non-destination amendments)

| Amendments already logged on the booking | Free allowance of the product | Charge for this amendment |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 2 | none |
| 1 | 2 | none |
| 2 | 2 | the amendment fee, once |
| 3 | 2 | the amendment fee, once |

The allowance and counts in the table are illustrative.

superseded_clauses: it is charged pod_change_fee_per_container_usd times the booking's container_count whatever the free allowance
